title: Phase 3: software architecture brainstorm
description:
Brainstorm on how sutra is structured as software (distinct from what it does). Key questions:
- One binary or multiple?
- Storage model (SQLite stays? additional stores?)
- Language adapter interface design
- API surface that all layers expose through (MCP tools, CLI, HTTP)
- Relationship to existing sutra code — rewrite, evolve, or hybrid?

This cuts across every capability and must be decided before subsystem PRDs.

Input: docs/sutra-vision.md
Output: architecture decisions captured in a doc
